verdict_unreadable: Cannot read clearly. Please retake the photo.
p05_mrp_missing: Mandatory MRP is missing or unclear on the visible packaging.
p10_barcode_checksum: Barcode/QR checksum failed. Potential counterfeit code.
p10b_gs1_india_prefix: Barcode does not carry an authorized GS1 India (890) prefix.
p09_expired: Product has passed its printed expiry date!
p11_fssai_invalid: Food product missing valid 14-digit FSSAI license number.
p14_huid_missing: Jewellery missing valid 6-character BIS HUID code.
g01_bill_of_supply_tax: Bill of Supply should not contain a tax amount.
g03_gstin_format: Supplier GSTIN is not in the valid 15-character format.
g04_gstin_checksum: Supplier GSTIN checksum fails. This is likely an invalid or fake GST number.
g05_pan_entity: GSTIN entity code mismatch. PAN linked to GSTIN does not match standard format.
g11_mrp_exceeded: The billed price is higher than the MRP on the pack! MRP is meant to include all taxes.
g12_invoice_no_missing: Invoice Number missing from the scan. Ensure it is clearly visible.
f01_id_missing: Document ID or Number is missing from the scan. Ensure the ID is clearly visible.
f02_name_missing: Name could not be extracted from the document.
